DeterminationBasis: Existing reproduction controls, including T16-015, require preservation of reproduction conditions and the result obtained under those conditions, but do not require the evidence package to contain or identify the material necessary for another party to perform the claimed reproduction. No existing T16 control directly establishes reproduction-material sufficiency or identification. CONF-017 therefore requires a distinct test.

Existing T16 controls govern claimed profile identity, requirements completeness, requirement statuses, blocking states and determination traceability, but none establishes that every mandatory general falsification test applicable to the claimed profile and declared scope was actually executed. TEST-001 therefore requires a distinct mandatory-test-execution completeness control.
